scientific_integrity: An explicit all-length combinatorial proof supports the result; exhaustive finite verification at lengths 4..16 corroborates but is not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Ternary linear words avoiding aa and abab; only one-symbol Hamming error detection with out-of-language rejection, not correction or mixed tandem-duplication errors; historical priority not independently established.
title: Exact substitution graph and detecting-code capacity of ternary short-tandem-irreducible words
